title: Cat Generator is up and working
author: DeadCatCreative
selftext:
One of the hurdles I hit a few weeks ago was how to get the customers to look unique while also not needing to hire a team of artists because I have no $ for that. I had a base idea of what I wanted the tool to be and how to interact with it, then used ChatGPT/Codex to ideate until the tool covered everything I needed and some of the things I never considered. I set Codex to build it out through the Unity MCP and here's what we got.

The Cat Generator can:

\- create, save, edit, and delete cat presets. These presets ensure that none of the Customer cats look the same as a Roster cat and so we don't have 15 versions of the same customer running around

\- Randomize fur color, eye color, pupil type, stripe opacity and color, and chest fur patterns

\- connects to the cat roster editor and the in-game roster to show the cat preview

All of this and it's built to easily add more configurable visual options as well as generic enough that I can plug it into any of my other projects and reuse it. I'm hoping to have the tutorial sequence done by the end of next week, but I bought a pack of decorative assets and I'm struggling to not go into full decorator mode lol
